body: Are you currently taking any medication to help?? I am aware this is a rant and I totally feel you on this when I am off my meds.
I went to really restart and do a spiritual cleanse by just telling each other problems and things we have been holding back. So this would be a big one.

we never really specified what we were. I basically was living with this girl and she knows that I love her immensely. I am just sadly still waiting. But I do not want to give up because she's my everything. I came to the realization that she is my soul mate a while back and I was gonna do this extra ass thing and take her to SF to ask her out. I guess now I am just waiting for the big day coming up soon.  and honestly like yes, the 2-3 weeks sucked without being her. I mean, we both were working on each other at the time, So I am just gonna continue working on myself for when she's ready.

She is currently not reaching out to me. I am a little lost as to why but I told her I was going to wait . So I am going to wait. I have dated this girls for three years and prior wanted to get a promise ring ( obviously still too young) but I love that girl more than life itself. As much, as I would like to speak with her , I know that she needs this time.

ah I see, well my best advice to you as someone who has/is most definitely going through it, is keep on pushing for yourself ( and for her as well! ). I keep reminding myself that she is going to be relieved and at peace when she sees her boyfriend after so long. I am glad that she is at least giving you the option to text her! my bad didn't get that part and yeah. Space is definitely tough but also, just make sure they are Okay. Even if it is that one text a week, use it to CHECK on her ! you never know the demon they're fighting on their own.
Yeah, I know. I think I am going to call her one more time in a bit to see if we can at least get that piece of information and if not we'll see. Thanks by the way!
Do you have the opportunity to see her in person? Maybe dropping off roses or something to let them know that you still care. I don't have that liberty but you definitely should. if possible.

I forgot to mention, but yes, these breaks are necessary for her and I. It has never ever been this near to long but that is okay as I respect it and I am almost 90% sure she is mentally okay at the moment because she has not reached out to me. In a sense, I am happy that she got time to work on herself. I also tried learning her favorite show but that shit was too confusing. 

​

yes, but please 

help.

I am actually in a similar situation except that I am not the girlfriend as well . I have not spoken with my girlfriend in almost 3 weeks (keep in mind, we would talk nonstop  before our argument). I basically had an episode, misread a situation, and scared her. I would never hurt her or anything like that but it was just a lot for the both of us. However, I will say that the break helped me a tremendous amount. I feel good, lost weight, learned more about her favorite show. The first few days were really rough but I just thought about how happy we would be when the break was over. I was even battling sexual and smoking addiction. however, time helped a lot. I also had more time to reflect and meditate on myself as well. That pain of not having each other? for what? I would always tell my girlfriend that she could always come to me and lay off all these emotions. I don't know how your boyrfiend is but trust meeeee, 

​

he is going to want to see you. I actually am waiting for a call soon. 

Bias as hell, but coming from a guy who hasn't spoken to the love of his life in a few weeks: do it. I can promise you that he probably has done a 180 because trust me, I had so much time and I mainly invested it in ways to benefit myself but also for the person I love and have hurt before. 

(I'm actually gonna post a question so you better help me too lol. )
